notes: Solved independently first. The driver hears the horn itself at n because driver and source move together. The cliff receives n·v/(v − v_c) as a stationary observer approached by the source, reflects it unchanged, and the driver then receives it as an observer moving toward that reflected source, giving f_echo = n(v + v_c)/(v − v_c). The difference is 2n·v_c/(v − v_c) = 0.10n, so 2v_c = 0.10(336 − v_c), 2.1v_c = 33.6, v_c = 16 m s⁻¹, option 3.
